ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

verification_categories_derived_from_spe: PICC POR sequence — field on → ≤ 5 ms → IDLE state, OTP loaded.
REQA + ATQA across all family variants (MIFARE Classic 1K / 4K / Plus SL1/SL2/SL3 / Ultralight / Ultralight C / Ultralight EV1 / DESFire EV1/EV2/EV3 / DESFire Light / NTAG21x / NTAG I2C).
WUPA wakes from both IDLE and HALT; REQA wakes only from IDLE.
Cascade Level 1 anti-collision (SEL = 0x93) for 4-byte UID PICCs.
Cascade Level 1 → Cascade Level 2 (SEL = 0x95) for 7-byte UID PICCs.
Cascade Level 1 → Cascade Level 2 → Cascade Level 3 (SEL = 0x97) for 10-byte UID PICCs.
Cascade Tag (0x88) in UID-CLn[0] of every non-final Cascade Level.
BCC verification (UID-CL[0..3] XOR) at every Cascade Level.
SAK bit 6 = 1 → PCD activates Layer 4 with RATS.
SAK bit 3 = 1 → PCD continues to next Cascade Level.
HLTA → HALT transition; PICC silent on REQA, responsive on WUPA.
Multi-PICC anti-collision — 2 PICCs in field, both Type A, distinct UIDs, no bit collision.
Multi-PICC anti-collision — 2 PICCs sharing UID prefix; PCD shall resolve via bit-frame bisection.
Multi-PICC anti-collision — 5 PICCs in field; PCD shall enumerate all via HALT loop.
Type A + Type B mixed-field — PCD alternates REQA and REQB; both PICCs detected.
RATS → ATS — exchange + TL/T0/FSCI/FWI/SFGI parsing.
PPS → PPS-RSP — bit-rate negotiation to 212 / 424 / 848 kbps.
T=CL I-Block round-trip with alternating block number.
T=CL R(NAK) — PCD retransmits with same block number.
T=CL S(WTX) — PICC requests time extension; PCD obeys.
T=CL S(DESELECT) — PCD ends session; PICC enters HALT.
CRC_A injection — PCD wrong CRC → PICC silent; PCD detects timeout and retries.
CRC_B injection — equivalent on Type B.
Parity injection (Type A) — PCD wrong parity → PICC silent.
Bit-frame anti-collision — PCD deliberately splits at wrong bit position; PCD shall recover.
GetVersion 0x60 on MIFARE Ultralight EV1 — verify 7-byte response and byte 2 = 0xX3.
GetVersion on MIFARE Plus EV1 — verify byte 2 = 0xX2.
GetVersion on MIFARE Plus EV2 — verify subtype byte 3.
GetVersion on MIFARE DESFire EV1 — verify byte 2 = 0xX1.
GetVersion on MIFARE DESFire EV2 — verify chained response (second GetVersion gets software block).
GetVersion on MIFARE DESFire EV3 — same as EV2 with subtype.
GetVersion on MIFARE DESFire Light — verify byte 2 = 0xX8.
GetVersion on NTAG21x — verify byte 2 = 0xX4 and storage-size encoding (e.g. 0x0F for NTAG213, 0x11 for NTAG215, 0x13 for NTAG216).
GetVersion on NTAG I2C — verify byte 2 = 0xX7.
GetVersion on legacy MIFARE Classic 1K — verify NAK; fallback to ATQA/SAK identification path.
Random ID mode — UID0 = 0x08; UID1..UID3 differ across two consecutive POR events.
fdt_listen ≤ 86.43 μs at 106 kbps across temperature corners (-25 °C, +85 °C).
FWT respected across FWI 0..14 corners.
PICC operating field corners — Hmin = 1.5 A/m and Hmax = 7.5 A/m.
PICC operating volume — Class 1 antenna 70 × 50 mm; PCD reads at all 6 ISO 10373-6 reference positions.
Carrier frequency tolerance — ± 7 kHz at PCD; PICC must operate across this range.
Long-frame test — maximum FSC = 256 bytes via FSCI = 8.
fields.notes: AN10833 does not include a formal verification plan or testbench. The categories above are derived from ISO/IEC 14443 Parts 2/3/4 plus AN10833 §2 + Figure 1 (decision tree) + Figure 3 (anti-collision loop). The normative compliance test framework is ISO/IEC 10373-6 — PCD and PICC test methods using reference Calibration Coil Antennas. EMVCo Contactless Specifications and NFC Forum Certification Tests are sibling normative compliance frameworks that subset ISO 14443 for specific application domains (payment, NFC Forum tags).
